summary: No role cleared every hard gate on November 6. Believe’s Staff Engineer Agentic AI in Paris is a hands-on staff role building a company-wide agent framework, but it publishes no pay and no office-day rule. Two postings first published on November 5 were rejected: Oyster’s fully remote Senior AI Product Engineer lists seventeen eligible countries, not including France, and Deepgram’s Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer is a sales-support role limited to the UK, Ireland and Switzerland. Unchanged earlier picks and near-misses are not repeated. These entries are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: Automated official-ATS sweep on November 6: 130 of 276 attempted Ashby, Lever and Greenhouse board aliases returned data; many failed aliases are likely wrong board names, not evidence of no vacancies. The sweep screened AI-titled roles on reachable boards, Paris- or France-located engineering roles with published pay on reachable Ashby boards, Greenhouse and Lever data for 111 France-located engineering roles (32 with pay text), and Ashby engineering roles first published since November 5 with a France or Europe-remote location. Compared with November 5’s sweep, it surfaced only a handful of new requisitions, none of which met the location and pay gates. A second pass reached 41 of 300 attempted aliases, a Workable and Recruitee check reached 6 of 44, and a pass over additional company names reached 49 of 315 attempted aliases. Six web searches were used for discovery only; leads were checked on employer pages, which added the Believe requisition. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE, unlabelled pay ranges and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked November 6, 2026. Unpublished pay is recorded as unknown, not as below the threshold; none of today’s entries publishes a salary figure.

OpenAI Deployment Company’s Forward Deployed Engineer - EU (qualified October 18) now also appears on a deploy.co careers page with the same €115K – €200K range and equity. The official Ashby board still shows the same requisition and July 6 publish date, so it is not a new role and is not counted today.

Brevo’s Technical Lead - AI Ops (screened October 30) remains listed with no published salary and no office-day rule. A search result showed a recruitment-firm Senior AI Engineer listing for an unnamed client (rejected October 25, €85K – €120K, 3–4 office days) with a fresh timestamp and the same terms; it was not reconfirmed on an employer page. Neither is treated as a new role.
Doctolib’s Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Applied AI & LLMs and Shift Technology’s two October near-misses show the same refreshed timestamps as on November 5 and still no published pay.
Search leads from aggregators, recruiters or freelance platforms without an identifiable employer page were not counted, including aggregator-only salary figures and estimates.
Deduplication covered the accessible October 10 to November 5 reports and the supplied October 3/5 Escape history.
Company financial diligence was not advanced because no role was ranked; the product notes are employer-stated only.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. Zero new roles qualified today. Believe would need a published base salary above €100,000 (or at least €80,000 with explicit equity) and an explicit Paris attendance rule. No applications or outreach were made.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer Agentic AI
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: location “Paris, France”; the SmartRecruiters job data marks the role neither remote nor hybrid, while the benefits section mentions a “Remote working policy”. No number of office or remote days is stated, so the attendance rule is unknown.[1][2]

salary.quote: No salary range or equity term is published on the listing or in the official job data. Pay is unknown, not below the threshold.[1][2]

reasons: Pay gate unverified: no employer-published base salary or equity.[1][2]
Location gate unverified: Paris-based, but no explicit hybrid attendance rule is published.[1][2]

AI centrality and seniority pass: a staff-level, hands-on role building Believe’s enterprise agentic framework (orchestration, retrieval, tool and MCP integration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) and its eval, guardrail and tracing layer. The listing asks for “5+ years in software engineering, including a meaningful stretch at a cross-team level of influence (Staff, Principal or equivalent), and recent experience taking LLM-based systems into production”.[1]
First released September 8, 2026 and not previously examined in this archive; the listing page and its “I’m interested” application button were reachable on the check date.[1][2]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: Believe is a music company that “supports the world’s music makers and rights holders at every stage of their journey”, working with artists, songwriters, labels and publishers. This role sits in Core Engineering beside the Agentic & Automation team and builds shared agentic services used by engineering, product, data and business teams across the group; the stated stack is Python, Java, GCP (including Vertex AI), Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, Spark, KrakenD and n8n. The specific internal agents to be built are not named.[1][3]
jobs.financials: Not publicly verified in this run. The listing describes Believe as a simplified joint-stock company under French law; no funding, revenue, profitability or headcount source was checked today.[1]
